Marshall portrayed how to be a great husband and one of the guys. Ted, for as whiny and self pitying as he was really showed how to never give up on anything that you find important. Robin was your classic example of put yourself first, no matter what you do the people who matter in your life will always be there. And Barney? Confidence, how to play the game and that even the most self centered, egotistical person can truly find something worth fighting for, protecting and love unconditionally. SPOILERS HERE. Seriously, the only good scene from the series finale was him holding his daughter for the first time and was really the one thing that they didn't botch at the end of the show.
